title: Distance between points
prompt: Return the distance between points a and b.
signature: func solve(a: Vector2, b: Vector2) -> float:
starter:
func solve(a: Vector2, b: Vector2) -> float:
	return 0.0
hint: Either take the length of the vector from a to b, or look for a method whose name says distance.
solution:
func solve(a: Vector2, b: Vector2) -> float:
	return a.distance_to(b)
